rationale: Raw source shows Q1 2026 total investment income of $22.498 million and a March 31, 2026 investment fair-value total of $934.425 million, implying an annualized income yield of about 9.63%. The filing independently discloses a 9.4% weighted average yield for the total debt portfolio. Thus 9.63% is below the source WAC plus 200 bps (11.4%). The flag metric of 2.72 implies a weak holdings-derived WAC near 6.91%, contradicted by the filing's disclosed 9.4% portfolio yield; the check anchor is bad, while the fund-financials value is supported.
